deviations: Reflection model: us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5 (Bedrock, effort low) instead of the default Opus 5.5 (median ~40 s/call in lc02); pre-registered in PREREG_reg01.md before any test seed ran.
SurrealDB was not on the per-reflection path in season runs (latency); box memory is authoritative. Pre-registered.

The SurrealDB forget response is NOT inside the branch worlds' surgery events: the Surreal demo (seed 8000, game-48 memory) ran after seed 8000's branches had launched. Surgery events carry the box-memory removal counts; the SurrealDB responses are in runs/reg01/surreal_forget.json and regulars.json.surreal_forget.

Semantic POST /forget {query:'everything about <name>', dryRun:true} returned {deleted:0} for both Avery and Blake: it did not match the person/<name> attributes. The real forget used the API's precise soft-delete, DELETE /entities/person/<name>. The real (dryRun:false) semantic /forget was never called: it matches by similarity across the whole shared context and could delete other experiments' memories.

DELETE /entities/person/Avery returned 500 {message:'unknown error'} on the first try; retried once (14:29:09) and succeeded (Avery attributes 9 -> 0). Blake succeeded on the first try (8 -> 0). Casey (9) and Drew (9) were untouched after both deletes.

Event schema is frozen (about/target are seats): decision/hypothesis/belief_superseded events carry about/target 'p3' plus extra fields about_name/target_name. Box memory and decision obs keep the names.
No-forget comparator = the parent season's own matches 17-20 (pre-registered); checkpoint-branch exactness verified on a non-LLM arm (seed 9901, not a test seed; tests/test_regulars.py).
A SurrealDB probe entity person/ProbeZed (scope lab/reg01/probe) was written to discover the /forget API, then soft-deleted.
The surreal_forget_demo function was added to blab/experiments/regulars.py after launch; the season/branch code that ran is saved verbatim in runs/reg01/regulars_at_launch.py.
